blocks.why: 'Bauklötze' is the plural; the singular field must hold a singular: der Bauklotz -> die Bauklötze

candy.why: 'Süßigkeiten' is the plural; the singular field must hold a singular: die Süßigkeit -> die Süßigkeiten. (If the picture shows a single wrapped sweet, 'das Bonbon' would be the more precise head — that would be a lemma change and is flagged here, not applied)

eyelashes.why: Plural form stored in the singular field. Duden: die Wimper -> die Wimpern. Not pluralia tantum - the singular exists.

flip-flops.why: Plural form stored in the singular field. Duden: der Flip-Flop -> die Flip-Flops (usually used in the plural, but the singular exists).

grapes.why: plural in the singular field (same defect class as blocks/candy). Pure form correction of the same lemma: die Traube → die Trauben. 'Eine Traube' also correctly names a whole bunch, which is what the image shows.

green-beans.why: plural in the singular field. Pure form correction of the same lemma: die grüne Bohne → die grünen/grüne Bohnen. Capitalised initial per this file's label convention.

high-heeled-shoes.why: plural in the singular field. Pure form correction of the same lemma: der Stöckelschuh → die Stöckelschuhe. Unlike 'gloves' there is no competing singular key here.

jelly-beans.why: a plural stands in the singular field (same defect class as 'blocks'/'candy'); the singular is die Geleebohne

potato-chips.why: plural in the singular field: 'Kartoffelchips' is the plural (Duden: Chip, der; -s, -s); the singular of the same lemma is 'der Kartoffelchip'. Same caveat as pasta — the supermarket image shows a mass, for which the plural is the natural spoken label

sandals.why: plural in the singular field (same defect class as 'blocks' = Bauklötze); the singular is die Sandale

slippers.why: plural form in the singular field; 'Hausschuhe' is not a pluralia tantum — der Hausschuh exists

air-conditioning.why: die Klimaanlage is a countable device, not a mass noun; the source metadata (countable:false) mirrors the English gerund 'air conditioning' and is wrong for German

allosaurus.why: 'Allosauren' is not a German form; German -saurus nouns take the -saurier plural
allosaurus.src: Duden pattern: Tyrannosaurus, der; -, ...rier / Brontosaurus, der; -, ...rier

ankylosaurus.why: 'Ankylosauren' is not a German form; German -saurus nouns take the -saurier plural

apatosaurus.why: 'Apatosauren' is not a German form; German -saurus nouns take the -saurier plural

argentinosaurus.why: 'Argentinosauren' is not a German form; German -saurus nouns take the -saurier plural

brachiosaurus.why: -saurus forms its plural on -saurier; 'Brachiosauren' is not a form

brontosaurus.why: -saurus forms its plural on -saurier; 'Brontosauren' is not a form

cactus.why: der Kaktus -> die Kakteen; 'Kakten' is not a German form
cactus.src: Duden: Kaktus, der; - und -ses, Plural Kakteen (umgangssprachlich auch Kaktusse)

carpenter.why: Occupational compounds in -mann take the -leute plural: der Zimmermann -> die Zimmerleute (as Kaufmann -> Kaufleute). 'Zimmermänner' occurs colloquially but is not the Duden headword plural

celery.why: Mass/kind noun for a vegetables picture; 'Sellerien' is not a form a child needs and the plural is marginal at best. p should equal s ('Sellerie')

cheese.why: Duden: der Käse, Plural: die Käse (zero plural). 'Käsen' does not exist.

chef.why: Duden: der Chef, Plural: die Chefs → Küchenchef, Plural: die Küchenchefs. 'Küchenchefe' is not a German form.

cranberry.why: Duden: die Cranberry, Plural: die Cranberrys. German forms the plural of English -y loanwords with -ys (Babys, Partys, Hobbys); 'Cranberries' is the English plural, not the German one.

crocus.why: Duden: der Krokus, Plural: die Krokusse. 'Kroken' is not a German form.

diamond.why: Singular is Raute (geometric rhombus, matches theme 'shapes'), but plural holds a different lemma (Diamanten = gemstones). Duden: die Raute -> die Rauten. Caveat: if the 'valentine' image shows a gemstone rather than a shape, the whole entry must move to Diamant/Diamanten (m).

driftwood.why: Treibholz is a mass noun (das Treibholz, -es; no plural in Duden). 'Treibholze' is a machine-formed non-word.

envelope.why: Duden: der Briefumschlag -> die Briefumschläge. The stored 'Briefumschlage' lacks the umlaut and is a non-word.

farmer.why: Duden: der Bauer -> die Bauern (weak declension). The naive '-er stays unchanged' default produced a non-word for a high-frequency farm word.

giganotosaurus.why: -saurus forms its plural in -saurier (Duden: 'Tyrannosaurus, der; -, ...rier'); 'Giganotosauren' is not a form. Word ends in -saurus (Greek sauros), not -taurus, so the rule applies.

grasshopper.why: the plural field holds a different lemma ('Grashüpfer', m., null plural) than the singular ('Heuschrecke', f.). No lemma decision needed — Heuschrecke is standard and correct, so the plural simply has to agree: die Heuschrecke → die Heuschrecken.

hot-dog.why: singular is spelled as one word 'Hotdog' but the plural as two words 'Hot Dogs' — same lemma, inconsistent spelling. Duden: der Hotdog, Plural Hotdogs

human-torso.why: adjective is not inflected for the plural: bare nominative plural takes the strong ending -e, so 'Menschliche Torsos', not 'Menschlicher Torsos'

ice-cream.why: p currently equals s, encoding 'no plural', but Duden gives die Eiscreme, Plural Eiscremes (loanwords in -creme take -s, cf. die Creme, die Cremes). Note: the child-natural word for the pictured item is 'Eis', which the key 'ice' already occupies

ichthyosaurus.why: -saurus (Greek sauros = lizard) forms its plural in -saurier, as with Tyrannosaurus, der; -, ...rier. 'Ichthyosauren' does not follow the Duden pattern

ironing-board.why: head noun is Brett: das Brett → die Bretter (umlaut + -er). 'Bügelbrette' is not a German form

mailbox.why: Duden: Briefkasten, der; -s, ...kästen. 'Briefkasten' as plural is the script's naive -en default; the plural umlauts

mosasaurus.why: -saurus builds its German plural on -saurier (Duden pattern: Tyrannosaurus, der; -, ...rier); the -sauren form is exactly the documented error. Mosa- + -saurus, so the rule applies (no -taurus exception here)

native-american.why: bare (article-less) adjective plural takes strong -e: 'Indigene Amerikaner'. The stored plural is just the singular copied — the script's naive -er default

octopus.why: 'Kraken' is the plural of 'Krake', a different lemma — no form of 'Oktopus'. Duden: Oktopus, der; -, ...pusse (also ...poden). Both words name the same animal, so no meaning decision is needed and the minimal same-lemma fix applies. (A consistent alternative pair would be Krake/Kraken, m.)

office-worker.why: bare adjectival noun: singular 'Büroangestellter', plural 'Büroangestellte'. The stored plural is just the singular copied — the script's naive -er default

orchard.why: der Garten → die Gärten, so der Obstgarten → die Obstgärten. 'Obstgarten' as plural is the script's naive -en default; the plural umlauts

oviraptor.why: Latin agent nouns in -or take -oren in German (Duden: Motor -> Motoren, Traktor -> Traktoren); 'Oviraptore' is not a German form. Note: the -saurus -> -saurier rule does not apply here (no -saurus head)

pachycephalosaurus.why: -saurus forms the plural in -saurier (Duden: Tyrannosaurus, der; -, ...rier); 'Pachycephalosauren' is not the German form

painting.why: themes=[activities] decides the reading: the picture shows the activity -> 'das Malen', a nominalised infinitive, which has no plural; p must equal s. The current 'Gemaelde' is a different lemma (the artwork), correct only if the image actually shows a painting rather than the act of painting

pegasus.why: proper name from Greek myth (the winged horse), like Jupiter — no established German plural; 'Pegasen' is not an attested form. p must equal s

pine-tree.why: Duden: Kiefer, die; -, -n (conifer) -> die Kiefern. The current null plural belongs to the homograph 'der Kiefer, -s, -' = the JAWBONE

plesiosaurus.why: -saurus forms the plural in -saurier (Duden: Tyrannosaurus, der; -, ...rier); 'Plesiosauren' is not the German form

pottery.why: themes=[activities] decides: 'das Toepfern' is a nominalised infinitive with no plural; p must equal s. The current 'Toepferei' is a different lemma (the craft/workshop)

pretzels.why: 'Brezelne' is an invented form that does not exist in German (Duden: Brezel, die; -, -n)

rainbow.why: Duden gives Regenbogen, der; -s, ...bögen — the plural is umlauted, not identical to the singular; the zero plural here is the script's -en default

roasted-turkey.why: two errors in one form: the noun plural is umlauted (Truthahn -> Truthähne, Duden) and the attributive adjective must take the plural ending -e, not the masculine singular -er; same lemma, pure form correction

rudolph.why: proper name of one specific reindeer (cf. Jupiter); 'Rudolphe' is an invented form — p must become identical to s

salt.why: themes = at_the_supermarket, i.e. table salt, a mass noun; the existing 'Salze' is the chemists' plural (kinds of salt) and is wrong for this picture — p must become identical to s

sandbox.why: Duden: Sandkasten, der; -s, ...kästen — the plural is umlauted; the zero plural here is the script's -en default

scrubs.why: head noun 'Kleidung' is a mass/collective noun; 'OP-Kleidungen' is not a usable German form — p must become identical to s

stegosaurus.why: -saurus forms its plural in -saurier; 'Stegosauren' is not a Duden form. Genuine -saurus (Greek sauros = lizard), so the carnotaurus exception does not apply

styracosaurus.why: -saurus forms its plural in -saurier; 'Styracosauren' is not a Duden form. Genuine -saurus, not the -taurus exception

sunscreen.why: 'Cremen' is the Austrian plural; standard German (Bundesrepublik) is Cremes → Sonnencremes

therizinosaurus.why: -saurus forms its plural in -saurier (Duden: Tyrannosaurus, der; -, ...rier); 'Therizinosauren' is not a German form

toolbox.why: Duden: Kasten, der; -s, Kästen — the head noun takes an umlaut plural; the zero plural comes from the script's naive -en default

uncle-sam.why: personification/proper name — no plural. 'Onkel Same' is a machine-invented form that does not exist (the script pluralized 'Sam' like a common noun); p must equal s

velociraptor.why: Latin -or nouns take -oren in German (Raptor → Raptoren, like Traktor → Traktoren, Motor → Motoren); 'Velociraptore' is not a form. Note: no -saurus here, so the -saurier rule does not apply

badminton.why: das Badminton, not der; 'm' is wrong

baking.why: substantivized infinitives are always neuter: das Backen; 'm' is wrong

beige.why: 'f' is wrong under any reading; a substantivized colour is neuter (das Beige). Note the colour set is internally inconsistent today (beige=f, black=m)

biking.why: substantivized infinitives are always neuter: das Radfahren; 'm' is wrong

black.why: 'm' is wrong under any reading; a substantivized colour is neuter (das Schwarz)

blue.why: The substantivised colour is neuter: das Blau, not 'der Blau'

boxing.why: Substantivised infinitives are without exception neuter: das Boxen. 'm' would render 'der Boxen' — the batch-01 'der Backen' class recurring here

brown.why: The substantivised colour is neuter: das Braun, not 'der Braun'

celery.why: Standard German (Bundesrepublik) is 'der Sellerie'; 'die Sellerie' is marked as Austrian by Duden and is wrong for this site's register
celery.src: Duden: Sellerie, der; -s, -[s], österreichisch nur die; -, -

christmas.why: Duden: Weihnachten, das — Substantiv, Neutrum ('das Weihnachten'). Masculine 'der Weihnachten' does not exist.

crimson.why: Colour names used as nouns are neuter in German: das Karmesinrot (like das Blau, das Rot). Masculine 'der Karmesinrot' does not exist.

dancing.why: Substantivized infinitives are always neuter: das Tanzen. Stored 'm' would be read as 'der Tanzen', which does not exist.

easter.why: Duden: Ostern, das - neuter, not masculine. 'der Ostern' does not exist.

extension-cord.why: Duden: das Kabel -> das Verlängerungskabel. Compound gender follows the head noun; 'der Verlängerungskabel' is wrong.

fishing.why: Substantivized infinitives are always neuter: das Angeln. 'der Angeln' does not exist (die Angel -> die Angeln is the fishing rod, a different lemma).

golf.why: Duden distinguishes 'Golf, das; -s' (the game) from 'Golf, der; -[e]s, -e' (the gulf/bay). Theme is sports, so the game is meant: das Golf. Current 'm' makes the site say 'der Golf' — the wrong word.

gray.why: colour names used as nouns are neuter: das Grau (cf. das Blau, das Braun). Current 'm' yields 'der Grau', which does not exist.

green.why: colour names used as nouns are neuter: das Grün. Current 'm' yields 'der Grün', which does not exist.

gymnastics.why: nominalised infinitives are without exception neuter: das Turnen. Current 'm' yields 'der Turnen'.

halloween.why: Duden: 'Halloween, das; -[s]' — neuter, like other festival names (das Weihnachten, das Ostern). Current 'm' yields 'der Halloween'.

hiking.why: nominalised infinitives are without exception neuter: das Wandern. Current 'm' yields 'der Wandern'.

hockey.why: Duden: 'Hockey, das; -s' — neuter. Current 'm' yields 'der Hockey'.

ice-skating.why: substantivized infinitives are without exception neuter: das Schlittschuhlaufen, not 'der Schlittschuhlaufen'

jumping.why: substantivized infinitives are without exception neuter: das Springen, not 'der Springen'

knitting.why: substantivized infinitives are without exception neuter: das Stricken, not 'der Stricken'

lego.why: das Lego, not 'der Lego' — the brand name is neuter

microphone.why: Duden: Mikrofon, das; -s, -e. 'der Mikrofon' does not exist

mixer.why: das Gerät → das Rührgerät. 'der Rührgerät' does not exist

package.why: Duden: das Paket, -[e]s, -e — neuter, not masculine; 'der Paket' would be read/spoken to children

perfume.why: Duden: das Parfuem, -s, -e/-s — neuter, not masculine

pine-tree.why: the tree is die Kiefer (f); 'der Kiefer' (m) is the jawbone — as encoded, a child sees/hears the wrong word entirely

pink.why: nominalised colour names are neuter (das Blau, das Braun) — Duden: das Rosa; 'der Rosa' does not exist

pottery.why: nominalised infinitives are without exception neuter: das Toepfern. The current 'f' belongs to the other lemma sitting in the p field (die Toepferei)

purple.why: substantivised colour names are neuter: das Lila (cf. das Blau, das Braun); 'm' is the script default

reading.why: substantivised infinitives are without exception neuter: das Lesen; cf. the identical key 'read' in this batch, which correctly carries 'n'

red.why: substantivised colour names are neuter: das Rot

running.why: substantivised infinitives are without exception neuter: das Laufen; cf. the identical key 'run' in this batch, which correctly carries 'n'

scarlet.why: substantivised colour names are neuter: das Scharlachrot

sewing.why: substantivised infinitives are without exception neuter: das Nähen

singing.why: nominalised infinitives are always neuter: das Singen, not 'der Singen'
singing.src: Duden grammar: substantivierte Infinitive sind Neutra

skating.why: das Schlittschuhlaufen — nominalised infinitives are neuter

skiing.why: das Skifahren — nominalised infinitives are neuter

sledding.why: das Rodeln — nominalised infinitives are neuter

snowboarding.why: das Snowboarden — nominalised infinitives are neuter

swimming.why: substantivized infinitives are always neuter: das Schwimmen; 'm' would yield 'der Schwimmen'

turquoise.why: theme is 'colors', so this is the colour: das Türkis (like das Blau, das Braun). 'der Türkis' is a different lemma — the gemstone
turquoise.src: Duden (two entries: der Türkis = Edelstein; das Türkis = Farbe)

ufo.why: Duden headword is 'Ufo/UFO, das' — the acronym stands for 'unbekanntes Flugobjekt' and takes the gender of Objekt (neuter). 'der UFO' has no standard support

venus.why: die Venus, not der. Most planets are masculine (der Mars, der Jupiter), but Venus and Erde are feminine — the naive rule was applied

white.why: substantivised colour names are neuter: das Weiß (like das Blau, das Braun). 'der Weiß' does not exist

writing.why: substantivised infinitives are without exception neuter: das Schreiben (like das Essen, das Backen). 'der Schreiben' does not exist

yellow.why: substantivised colour names are neuter: das Gelb (like das Blau, das Braun). 'der Gelb' does not exist
